The parties now desire to amend the Original Agreement to make revisions to the Original Agreement as the parties deem appropriate. AGREEMENT NOW, THEREFORE, with reference to the foregoing Recitals, in consideration of the mutual covenants contained herein, and for other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which are hereby acknowledged, the parties hereby agree as follows: 1. Section 6 of the Original Agreement is hereby restated in its entirety to read in full as set forth below: Section 6 of the Original Agreement is hereby restated in its entirety to read in full as set forth below: “6. Facility Payments . (a) When any SPE Property is sold or transferred (other than to a wholly owned subsidiary of the SPE or a 2 nd Tier SPE), in whole or in part, which SPE Property has been acquired using principal drawn from the Facility, ExchangeRight must repay the respective principal balance of the Facility associated with such SPE Property no later than the day before the last day of Lender’s fiscal quarter in which the sale or transfer occurs. (b) The parties acknowledge and agree that beginning July 1, 2024 the following fees shall be payable to Lender in connection with providing the Facility to Lender: (i) A one quarter percent (0.25%) unused Facility fee (the “ Unused Facility Fee ”), which Unused Facility Fee shall be calculated as the total available Facility amount (i.e., $250,000,000) less the drawn amount and taking the average of that unused Facility balance on a daily basis and multiplying it by an annualized one quarter percent (0.25%) rate, which Unused Facility Fee shall be payable by ExchangeRight quarterly in arrears; and (ii) A one quarter percent (0.25%) annual access fee (the “ Annual Access Fee ”), which shall be calculated as the total available Facility amount (i.e., $250,000,000) multiplied by an annualized one quarter percent (0.25%) rate on a daily basis, which Annual Access Fee shall be payable by ExchangeRight quarterly in arrears.” - 1 - - 1 - - 1 - 2. Executive Summary - In September 2024, ExchangeRight Real Estate, LLC and ExchangeRight Income Fund Operating Partnership, LP entered into a first amendment to their uncommitted senior revolving secured line of credit agreement. - ExchangeRight Real Estate, LLC, a California limited liability company, serves as the borrower, while ExchangeRight Income Fund Operating Partnership, LP, a Delaware limited partnership, acts as the lender in this intra-company financing arrangement. - The original credit agreement was dated April 4, 2022, and this amendment introduces new fee structures and modifies repayment terms for the facility. - The amendment establishes two new fees effective July 1, 2024: an unused facility fee and an annual access fee, both at 0.25% annually, payable quarterly in arrears. The facility appears to support real estate acquisitions by Special Purpose Entities (SPEs), with mandatory repayments required when SPE properties are sold or transferred. ## 2. Investment Highlights & Risks ### Key Strengths / Credit Positives: - Secured facility with collateral backing, providing enhanced creditor protection - Mandatory repayment provisions upon property sales ensure principal recovery and deleveraging - Intra-company structure may provide more flexible terms and alignment of interests - Fee income generation (0.50% total annual fees) enhances lender returns ### Principal Risks and Mitigating Factors: - Uncommitted facility structure provides no guarantee of funding availability when needed - Intra-company lending may lack arm's length negotiation and independent oversight - Real estate-focused lending exposes the facility to property market volatility - Limited information on underlying collateral quality, borrower financial condition, or broader covenant structure ## 3.
